image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced meatloaf resting in a crinkled aluminum foil pan. The loaf is oblong and has been cut into approximately six thick slices. It features a dark brown, textured interior consistent with ground meat and a glossy, deep red glaze on the top and edges, likely tomato-based. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the glaze and the foil.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The glaze has an overly uniform, plastic-like sheen in some areas, and the boundaries between slices are exceptionally clean, lacking the slight crumbling or irregularity often seen in real sliced meatloaf. This suggests potential AI smoothing.

The folds in the aluminum foil appear somewhat illogical and 'melted' in the bottom left corner, lacking the sharp, crisp creases typical of real foil. The reflection patterns are also slightly inconsistent with the light source.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' quality of the glaze. Real meatloaf glaze often bubbles or breaks; this one looks very smooth. Also, inspect the foil pan—AI often struggles with the complex specular reflections of crumpled metal. Check if the slices look like they were cut by a knife (compression marks) or just separated digitally.
